# New

### Curio
* Added a Profiles feature which allows creating and applying buy profiles to characters.
* Added a small one time note that Curio only works with a fully unlocked shop.

### Library
* Added a Resize Window In Library to global settings (On by default) that, when turned off, will disable Library Mode resizing Alexandria.
* Additionally reworked window resizing to more consistently save custom window positions when moving in and out of the Library.

### General
* Added a Text Size setting that allows scaling the text of the entire app up/down.
